body:
Greg's standing rules that now live in repository text, with their sources and the details the text leaves out.

- Work only in the repository folder (Greg, 2026-09-26): CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, "Work only in the repository folder"; it matches Engram commit 535a8b0. Cause (bead tm-t1gh): a background PowerShell script assigned $home; the assignment failed because $HOME is read-only and names ignore case, and its recursive delete of $home removed most of C:\Users\grzeg. Greg's scope decision, relayed by Engram::Advisor: TermAl will not block dangerous operations (Engram item w-bf5b12465446 cancelled), so the rule holds only through instructions. Also (Fable, 2026-09-06): before ending a landing or verification script, remove its own scratch files.
- Superseded provenance: Greg's standing rule of 2026-09-02 said never to create git worktrees, sibling checkouts or hidden workspaces inside or outside the main checkout, to keep concurrent changesets apart by file ownership and explicit staging lists, and to ask Greg before any isolation. CLAUDE.md now sanctions worktrees inside the repository. Anything outside the repository stays forbidden by the rule above.
- No tracker ids in code (Greg, 2026-08-14): CLAUDE.md, "Engram work tracker". Comments explain the invariant in words that stay readable after the tracker context is gone.
- "Fair Temp usage act" (Greg, 2026-09-06, after 22k leaked fixture directories saturated the SSD): (1) every temporary artifact TermAl or its agents create under the user temp directory lives under ONE product subfolder (%TEMP%\termal\...; CodeNav may use its own root), never directly in %TEMP%; (2) whoever creates a temp artifact removes it: tests clean up on every path, and a bounded stale sweep at process start covers crashed or killed runs; (3) test wrappers point TMP/TEMP at the product subfolder so unguarded callers are contained too, report the before/after count, and fail on a positive delta; (4) removal failures are diagnosed and fixed, never hidden with retries. It applies to Rust tests, Vitest, delegation checkouts and Engram. docs/test.md describes the implementation. Scope since 2026-09-26: agents' own scratch goes under .tmp/ in the repository, not %TEMP%.
- Leaked-root check (Fable, 2026-09-06, procedure from gate-windows-exclude-release-builds, kept verbatim): "Also check %TEMP% for leaked termal-test-state roots after test runs until the leak fix lands." Its retirement condition is a landed leak fix cited by commit; none is cited here, so the check stands. The wrappers' before/after leak report in (3) above complements it but is not recorded as covering those roots.
- Test output (Greg, 2026-09-19, clarified 2026-09-22): kept in full in testing-gates-and-credit, "Test output and waiting".
- No "flaky test" category, and the failed-gate procedure (Greg, 2026-08-23, reaffirmed): CLAUDE.md "Working on the UI" and "Failed gate investigation"; reasoning-evidence-and-verification-b, rules T1 and T2.
